text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While the Mejiro legacy is still fresh in people's memories, for Mejiro Dober, the challenge of the Twinkle Series is about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her goal is to become a strong racer who can always run confidently, and we decide the first step toward that goal is to leave a good impression during her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Mejiro Bright, a fellow member of the Mejiro family and Mejiro Dober's peer, comes by. Their partner running is so intense that even the surrounding observers get riled up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Watching them, I'm confident that Mejiro Bright will be a wonderful rival for Mejiro Dober. And thus, our three years together begin!
